scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c white,blue "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:server:infisical: infisical run --env=prod -- npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n client,server -c white,blue "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n client,staff,server -c white,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w staff" "npm run dev:server:infisical"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w staff
scripts.user:export:infisical: infisical run --env=prod -- npm run user:export -w server --
scripts.user:delete:infisical: infisical run --env=prod -- npm run user:delete -w server --
